notes: Versioned server<->SDK compatibility policy (honua-support#42). This is a curated, checked-in artifact, NOT a package-registry 'latest' feed: an approvedTarget is the highest version support has cleared against the deployed server family, which is deliberately not the newest release (e.g. sdk-js 7.x is a major that is not approved against server 2.x). Version ranges use space-separated comparators (>=, >, <=, <, =); every comparator in a range must hold. A (sdk, server) pair matches a knownBad window before it is considered supported.

knownBad.summary: sdk-js 5.x emits legacy FeatureServer query parameters that server 2.4+ rejects; the pairing is a known-incompatible window.
Honua .NET SDK 3.x pins a metadata-v1 contract that server 2.4+ no longer serves by default; the pairing is a known-incompatible window.
honua-sdk-python 1.x uses the pre-2.4 pagination envelope that server 2.4+ removed; the pairing is a known-incompatible window.
